## 问题修复

- 修复以托盘模式启动或关闭主窗口最小化到托盘后，任务栏仍显示图标或空白窗口的问题。
- 修复托盘右键菜单及其子菜单初次展开时一片空白、必须移动鼠标才能显示内容的问题。

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed taskbar icons or blank windows remaining when starting in tray mode or closing the main window to the tray.
- Fixed tray context menus and submenus appearing blank on first opening until the pointer moved over them.
